prayerExcerpt.en-US: A cloth is spread on the altar, and a corporal and the Missal put in place.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Sobre o altar estende-se a toalha e colocam-se o corporal e o Missal.

meta.basis: The Missal is prepared 'next to the Priest’s chair' and, at the Preparation of the Gifts, placed on the altar with the corporal, purificator, chalice and pall (GIRM 118a, 139); the Good Friday rubric of the excerpt names it with the cloth and the corporal. Liturgical books are to be 'truly worthy, dignified, and beautiful' (GIRM 349). The bookstand, the leather binding and the ribbon markers in the liturgical colours are traditional forms, not prescribed ones.
